result.topic_en: Calculations on a logarithmic potential for two circles via bilinear (Möbius) transformation and parameter relations, followed by notes on potential theory: divergence/curl conditions, the jump of the potential across a double layer, and the line integral of a force field (Stokes-type circulation).

Reflection condition for circle with centre c, radius b: product of parameters
Logarithmic potential via logarithm of a Möbius ratio
